SELECT
TO_CHAR(TRUNC(n.VISIT_DATE, 'MM'), 'YYYY-MM')
TO_CHAR(TRUNC(n.VISIT_DATE), 'YYYY-MM-DD')
AS itemDate, n.OPERATOR_NO AS operNo, COUNT(1) AS rcptCnt, COUNT(DISTINCT n.PATIENT_ID) AS personCnt FROM outp_rcpt_master n WHERE n.VISIT_DATE >= #{startDate} AND n.VISIT_DATE < #{endDate} + 1 AND n.TOTAL_CHARGES < 0 AND n.OPERATOR_NO IN
#{op}
AND n.OPERATOR_NO = #{operatorNo}
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM outp_rcpt_master o WHERE o.RCPT_NO = n.REFUND_RCPT_NO AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM outp_treat_rec_t t WHERE t.RCPT_NO = o.RCPT_NO AND t.PRE_HOSPITAL <= 1 ) ) GROUP BY n.OPERATOR_NO,
TRUNC(n.VISIT_DATE, 'MM')
TRUNC(n.VISIT_DATE)
ORDER BY itemDate, operNo

#{id}
